correctness.rationale: The criterion U wedge V subset W yields quotient exterior-square subspace W', and each lift is a graph map. Full automorphisms include all central shears, which act transitively on graph fibers; the remaining action is GL(V/U). The low-codimension orbit boundary reduces to GL_k transitivity for k at most three and projective alternating-form ranks two/four for k=4. Orbit sizes multiply the exact Gaussian counts by graph-lift counts. Characteristic two is included because exterior alternating form normal forms are characteristic independent. Independent finite checks: all 45 L_3(F2) ideals, complete GL4(F2) orbit partition 35+28, ternary projective-form ranks 130+234, Gaussian identity tests for 2,3,5.

value.rationale: The codimension-five boundary is mathematically natural: it is the first point at which fixed generator/derived defects do not force a single ideal orbit. The exact four-orbit partition determines a complete low-codimension automorphism invariant and quantifies the onset of non-homogeneity in every free two-step Lie algebra of generator rank at least five. It is a sharp finite cutoff, not a relabeling or arbitrary singleton computation.
